title: ESRC WRDTP studentship
about: The White Rose Doctoral Training Partnership, United Kingdom, runs its ESRC WRDTP studentship competition for doctoral students starting in October 2027. Applicants submit their materials by 17:00 on 20 January 2027; departments then nominate candidates by 24 February 2027.
requirements: Must not have already commenced a PhD

upskill.name: AI for Education Academy
why: No course scored at least 6 with a genuine match: the shortlist only matched the word "social" (social media marketing, social AI). Fallback to the AI for Education Academy page, which hosts research and academic productivity courses relevant to doctoral applicants in "Social sciences".

card_alt: EduCut Connect card for the ESRC WRDTP studentship offered by the White Rose Doctoral Training Partnership (WRDTP), United Kingdom, deadline 20 Jan 2027. The photo shows Big Ben and Westminster Bridge in London, a general UK image rather than the partnership's location.
